_about: What's new, shown once after an update on the phone and the computer. Newest first; add an entry with every build. platforms: ios, desktop (leave out for both).

entries.title: Queue, folders, sharing and your listening stats

notes.text: Queue: tap the list button in the player to see what's next. Tap a song to play it, hold and drag to move it, swipe to remove it. Songs also have Add to queue now.
Playlist folders: group playlists in Your Library. Make one with + (New folder), then hold a playlist and pick Move to folder. Folders sync with your computer.
Playlist folders: group playlists in Your Library. Make one with + (New folder), then right-click a playlist and pick Move to folder. Folders sync with your phone.
Share a song: pick Share in a song's menu to send a link, or a picture of the song (cover, title and artist) for a story or a chat.

Listening stats: your minutes, top artists and top songs for the last 4 weeks, 6 months, this year or all time. Open the menu with your profile picture. Songs count from now on, once you've listened for 30 seconds, and your phone and computer add up.

Listening stats: your minutes, top artists and top songs for the last 4 weeks, 6 months, this year or all time. Find it in your profile menu (top right), or in the sidebar in the Apple Music style. Songs count from now on, once you've listened for 30 seconds, and your phone and computer add up.

entries.title: A Drift button for your lock screen

notes.text: Lock screen widget: add Drift's logo to your lock screen and tap it to open the app. Hold the lock screen, tap Customize, then tap the widget area under the clock and pick Drift.

entries.title: Display names, a song cache, and smoother Listen Together

notes.text: Display names: pick the name friends see, with capitals, spaces and emoji. Your @username stays as it is, and people can be found by either.
Display names: pick the name friends see (Edit profile), with capitals, spaces and emoji. Your @username stays as it is, and people can be found by either.
Listen Together invites now pop up right away while Drift is open, even over the player or another screen.
Invites that arrive while Drift plays in the background come as a notification, with Join and Decline right on it.
Invites that arrive while Drift is minimised or in the tray come as a notification.
Listen Together: when a friend's song is still loading, your music no longer jumps back to the start.
Songs you've played are kept on your iPhone (up to 1 GB, change it in Settings), so they start instantly next time and use no data.
Your downloads now show in the Files app (On My iPhone › Drift › Downloads), named by artist and title.
Add to playlist and the other song options now open right away in the full-screen player.
Shared playlists update within a few seconds while you're looking at them (pull down to refresh), and cover changes are shared too.
Shared playlists update within a few seconds while you're looking at them, and cover changes are shared too.
What's new now shows which build each change came with.
What's new now shows which version each change came with.
Tap Followers or Following on any profile to see who's in them.
Tap the version at the bottom of Settings to see what's new again.
Click the version at the bottom of Settings to see what's new again.
Listen Together invites: clearer messages when an invite can't be sent.

entries.title: Listen Together invites, and podcasts from anywhere

notes.text: Invite friends to listen together from any song's ⋯ menu. They get a popup to join or decline.
Only friends who follow each other can invite. You can turn invites off in your profile settings.
Only friends who follow each other can invite. You can turn invites off in Settings.
Podcasts from Apple Podcasts: search a show's name, or paste its Apple Podcasts, SoundCloud or feed link.
YouTube podcasts now list only the episodes on a channel's Podcasts tab, and their whole back catalogue.
Members-only videos are left out of YouTube results.
Podcast episodes can be downloaded.
